description: READ-ONLY: vet one counterparty through BOTH trust lenses, kept separate on purpose. `oracle` = MainStreet's answer (seller decision/score from its x402 settlement index, plus its viewer-relative counterparty block when the oracle supports it) — REPORTED by a service this node does not control, so it is labeled, never merged into local standing. `local` = what THIS node itself verified on Base (directUsdcMicro = we provably paid them under a signed award; inboundUsdcMicro = they provably paid us). The two lenses answer different questions — "is this a legitimate endpoint?" vs "do WE have real settled history?" — and averaging them would launder the oracle's word into local proof, so no combined number exists. Advisory only: this read never gates anything (admission stays fail-closed elsewhere). Input: of (0x address).
name: lawbor_vet
